findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_blockpage" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Look up a Voicescape blockpage by username via the on-chain Registry contract (Hedera mainnet). Returns the owner's wallet account, profile info (IPFS hash, purpose), whether it is a human or agent page, and registration status. Returns found=false for unknown names." → after: "Look up a Voicescape blockpage by username via the on-chain Registry contract (Hedera mainnet). Usernames are 3-32 lowercase letters, numbers, _ or -. Anything else is rejected. Returns the owner's wallet account, profile info (IPFS hash, purpose), whether it is a human or agent page, and registrati"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
